name: Aerthos

theme.technologyLevel: Bronze Age / early Iron Age, with magical advancements
theme.genericBackground: Aerthos is a world where ancient civilizations thrive amidst forgotten ruins and powerful magic. Life flourishes under the light of Solus and the two moons, Lunara and Nyx, each influencing the world and its inhabitants in subtle ways. The very air hums with latent arcane energy, allowing for various forms of magic, from subtle enchantments to powerful rituals. The world is geographically diverse, from island archipelagos to sprawling mainland forests and harsh southern wastes, each shaping the cultures that inhabit them. History is long and layered, filled with tales of creation, conflict, and the enduring struggle for balance between races and nature.
theme.relationships: The Elves, master seafarers and magic-users, maintain a 'normal' relationship with the Human kingdoms through trade, providing exotic goods and arcane knowledge in exchange for vital metals like tin and copper, which are scarce on their islands. While generally peaceful, a respectful distance is maintained. The Humans, industrious and expansive, often find themselves on the front lines against the more primitive and violent Orcish tribes to the south, leading to constant border skirmishes and larger conflicts. The Orcs, driven by tribal honor and a desire for resources, see the Human lands as fertile raiding grounds. Relations between the Human kingdoms themselves are complex, ranging from cautious alliances to simmering rivalries, often influenced by resource control and political ambition. There is little to no direct interaction between Elves and Orcs, with the Elves viewing the Orcs as a distant, brutish threat to be avoided.
theme.rules: Magic is an inherent part of Aerthos. Elven magic tends to be more refined, focused on elemental control, illusions, and healing, often tied to moon cycles and natural energies. Human magic is more diverse, encompassing practical enchantments for tools and weapons, defensive wards, and some forms of divination, often drawing on their unique connection to metals. Orcish magic is raw, shamanistic, and often violent, manifesting as battle-trance enhancements, curses, and primal summoning. Resources are geographically segregated: Elves control sea routes and exotic island resources, while Humans possess rich metal veins essential for their technological progression. The political landscape reflects this: Elves operate as a unified island kingdom, Humans as competing mainland monarchies, and Orcs as nomadic, warring clans. Disease and natural disasters are significant threats, often attributed to divine displeasure or magical imbalances.
theme.specifics: Elven society is matriarchal and deeply tied to the rhythms of the sea and the moons, with their villages often featuring intricate, naturally grown architecture. Their ships are renowned for their speed and a unique form of 'wind-weaving' magic. Human cities, particularly in the Kingdom of Ironpeak, boast impressive fortifications and intricate metalworking, while Eldoria focuses on grand temples and scholarly pursuits. Orichalcum, a rare, magically infused metal, is rumored to exist in hidden veins, sought after by all races for its potent properties. Whispers of ancient, forgotten races and their ruinous magics persist in old texts and unexplored territories, hinting at a past far grander and more perilous than current events.

calendar.name: The Calendar of Aerthos
calendar.details: The Calendar of Aerthos is based on the orbits of the two moons, Lunara and Nyx, and the solar cycle. A year consists of 13 cycles of Lunara, with each cycle lasting 28 days, totaling 364 days. An additional 'Day of Balance' is added every four years to align with the solar year. Months are named after prominent constellations and significant celestial events, reflecting both Elven and Human traditions.

technologyLevel: Bronze Age / early Iron Age, enhanced by magic

stars.description: The life-giving sun of Aerthos, around which all planets and moons orbit. It is the primary source of light and warmth, revered by all races, though often seen differently: as a symbol of enlightenment by Elves, of strength by Humans, and of raw power by Orcs.
stars.name: Solus

planets.description: The closest planet to Solus, fiery and tempestuous. Believed to be the domain of elementals and raw magical energy, it appears as a bright, pulsating star in the dawn sky.
planets.name: Ignis

planets.description: A lush, green world, visible as a morning star. It is associated with fertility, growth, and the natural cycle of life. Human druids often draw power from its alignment.
planets.name: Viridia

planets.description: A swift, nimble planet often seen darting across the sky. Believed to influence trade, communication, and swift journeys. Merchants and messengers often pray to its guiding light.
planets.name: Celeris

planets.description: A large, golden-hued gas giant, named after the patron deity of justice and prosperity. Its slow, majestic orbit is seen as a symbol of stability and order.
planets.name: Justitia

planets.description: A red, turbulent world, associated with conflict, courage, and the forge. Orcish shamans claim to hear the drums of their ancestors from its distant light.
planets.name: Bellum

planets.description: A shimmering, ice-blue world, distant and mysterious. Elves believe it is a realm of ancient spirits and forgotten lore, its cold light holding secrets of the cosmos.
planets.name: Glacius

planets.description: The outermost known planet, cloaked in perpetual shadow. It is rarely seen and shrouded in superstition, often associated with the unknown, death, and primordial chaos.
planets.name: Umbra

constellations.description: A prominent constellation resembling a warrior with a spear, said to represent the first human king, 'King Arion'. It is used by human navigators and celebrated in their winter festivals.
constellations.name: The Spear of Arion

constellations.description: A delicate, flowing constellation resembling a mythical sea serpent. Elves believe it guides their ships and protects them from storms. It features heavily in Elven maritime legends.
constellations.name: The Serpent of the Deep

constellations.description: A fierce cluster of stars forming the head of a charging boar. Orcish shamans interpret its movements for omens of war and plentiful hunts, often appearing during the harsh winter months.
constellations.name: Grom's Tusk

moons.description: The larger and brighter of Aerthos's two moons, Lunara is associated with tides, magic, and life. Its silvery light is revered by the Elves, who believe it amplifies their arcane abilities. Lunara governs the cycles of the Elven calendar.
moons.name: Lunara, the Silver Weaver

moons.description: Smaller and darker, Nyx often appears as a reddish orb in the night sky. It is associated with shadows, hidden knowledge, and the wilder aspects of magic. Orcs often associate Nyx with battle fury and primal instincts, believing it calls them to war.
moons.name: Nyx, the Crimson Hunter

oceans.description: The vast, deep ocean that surrounds the known continents of Aerthos. It is the primary domain of Elven exploration and trade, its currents carrying ancient magic. Many mythical creatures are said to dwell in its uncharted depths.
oceans.name: The Mare Aetherium

seas.description: A large, relatively calm sea bordered by the mainland human kingdoms to the north and the Elven islands to the south. It is the primary trade route between humans and elves, traversed by Elven merchant ships.
seas.name: The Azure Straits

seas.description: A rougher, often storm-tossed sea to the west of the human mainland, prone to strong currents and dangerous reefs. It is less traveled by Elven ships but is where the Kingdom of Ironpeak has its few ports.
seas.name: The Iron Sea

rivers.description: The longest river in the Human lands, flowing from the Spine of Aerthos through the Kingdom of Veritas and eventually emptying into the Iron Sea. It is a vital artery for trade and agriculture.
rivers.name: The River Veritas

rivers.description: A swift-flowing river originating in the Verdant Veil and winding through the Kingdom of Eldoria before reaching the coast. Its waters are considered sacred by the priests of Eldoria, believed to possess minor healing properties.
rivers.name: The Silverflow

landmarks.description: A colossal mountain range forming the southern border of the human kingdoms, riddled with rich veins of copper and tin. Its jagged peaks are home to fierce beasts and ancient dwarven ruins.
landmarks.location: Southern border of Human Kingdoms (Ironpeak, Veritas)
landmarks.name: The Spine of Aerthos

landmarks.description: A vast, ancient forest on the mainland, known for its towering, moss-draped trees and hidden magical springs. It is a place of mystery and ancient fey encounters, often avoided by common folk.
landmarks.location: Central Mainland, between Veritas and Eldoria
landmarks.name: The Verdant Veil

landmarks.description: A series of sunken, crystalline spires that once formed an ancient Elven city before being submerged. Legends say powerful artifacts and forgotten knowledge lie within its watery depths, accessible only to the most skilled Elven divers.
landmarks.location: Beneath the Azure Straits, near Silverhaven
landmarks.name: The Sunken Spires of Eldrin

landmarks.description: A formidable fortress built into the cliffs overlooking the Iron Sea. It serves as the primary defense against Orcish incursions and a key naval base for the Kingdom of Ironpeak.
landmarks.location: Coastal cliffs of Kingdom of Ironpeak, overlooking the Iron Sea
landmarks.name: The Bastion of Iron

landmarks.description: A desolate, volcanic plateau to the south, characterized by black rock formations and active geysers. This is the primary territory of the Ashfang Tribes, a harsh land that forges their fierce nature.
landmarks.location: South of Human Kingdoms, across the Ashfang Gap
landmarks.name: The Scorched Wastes

countries.name: The Elven Kingdom of Aethelgard
countries.politicalSystem: Monarchy, led by an immortal Arch-King/Queen

countries.name: Kingdom of Veritas
countries.politicalSystem: Monarchy with a Council of Nobles

countries.name: Kingdom of Eldoria
countries.politicalSystem: Theocratic Monarchy, ruled by a Divine Emperor/Empress

countries.name: The Ashfang Tribes
countries.politicalSystem: Nomadic Tribal Confederacy, led by a War-Chief
